notes.title: Atmosphere and wave variety update
notes.content:
-added new entities scattered around each level: 
The Tormented- humans whose physical bodies are frozen in time but their souls remain in endless suffering

-added new wave variation that will randomly occur: 
the clock chime will have a lower pitch and a new enemy variant called the "Voidwalkers" will be the only enemies to spawn for 1 wave

-bug fixes
